movelist.name: Thunder Cage
movelist.effect: The targets are trapped in a Vortex. The DC to escape the Vortex is increased by 3.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Electroweb
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are lowered 1 Speed Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Transistor
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a damaging Electric-Type Move
abilities.effect: One target hit by the attack becomes one stage more vulnerable to the attack (applied after all other modifiers). Immune targets are treated as initially double-resistant for the purposes of this Ability, and may be damaged normally.

abilities.name: Absorb Force
abilities.trigger: The user is damaged by a Physical Attack
abilities.effect: The user takes damage as if the attack was resisted one step further.

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.effect: Whenever the user attacks, they ignore all positive Combat Stages to the target’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed.
